def factor_vwap_sma_range_regime(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    prev_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    tr = pd.concat([(df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]),
                    (df_copy["high"] - prev_close).abs(),
                    (df_copy["low"] - prev_close).abs()], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    norm_tr = tr / df_copy["close"]
    mean_tr = norm_tr.rolling(20).mean()
    std_tr = norm_tr.rolling(20).std(ddof=1)
    cv_tr = std_tr / mean_tr.replace(0, np.nan)
    compression = 1.0 / (1.0 + cv_tr)
    vwap = (df_copy["close"] * df_copy["volume"]).rolling(20).sum() / df_copy["volume"].rolling(20).sum()
    sma = df_copy["close"].rolling(20).mean()
    div = (vwap - sma) / df_copy["close"]
    factor = div * compression
    df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_range_regime"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_range_regime"]
description: Range-based volatility compression modulates VWAP-SMA divergence. When normalized true range has low rolling coefficient of variation (compressed volatility), price-volume coherence (VWAP vs SMA) becomes a stronger signal; during volatility expansion, the divergence is attenuated. This changes the raw information pathway from binary compression gates to a continuous volatility-regime interaction while preserving the price-volume coherence mechanism.
